review.tagline: Python agent library where the model writes its actions as code
review.summary: smolagents is a Python library from Hugging Face for building agents. Its main class, CodeAgent, has the LLM write each action as a Python snippet, so tool calls become function calls. The core logic in agents.py is under 1,000 lines. It also ships ToolCallingAgent (JSON tool calls), multi-agent hierarchies, and the smolagent and webagent CLIs.
review.audience: Python developers building code-writing or tool-calling agents
strengths: Core agent logic fits in under 1,000 lines, easy to read and modify
Works with local transformers, Ollama, HF providers, OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Bedrock, LiteLLM
Tools can come from MCP servers, LangChain or Hub Spaces
Sandboxed execution via E2B, Blaxel, Modal or Docker
weaknesses: Built-in LocalPythonExecutor is not a security boundary and can be bypassed
Safe code execution needs an external sandbox or Docker setup
Library only: no web UI, server or deployment layer included
Efficiency claims (30% fewer steps) come from linked papers, not reproduced in the README
needs: Needs E2B, Blaxel, Modal or Docker (for sandboxing), LLM provider or local model
Models: transformers, Ollama, HF Inference Providers, OpenAI-compatible APIs, Azure OpenAI
